posts.title: Never forget: the web is made of people!
posts.description: The web is much more than a set of technologies; it is fundamentally a human network. Like the Web 2.0 maxim goes: the web is made of people. And that's just as true in the AI era. The post Never forget: the web is made of people! appeared first on Richard MacManus .

posts.title: When the user interface moves from pages into agents
posts.description: As interfaces move inside agents, apps, brands and content systems are being broken into machine-readable components. The post When the user interface moves from pages into agents appeared first on Richard MacManus .

posts.title: The agentic web’s infrastructure layer is starting to form
posts.description: The agentic web is starting to look less like a theory and more like infrastructure — with commerce, governed actions and identity layers beginning to form. The post The agentic web’s infrastructure layer is starting to form appeared first on Richard MacManus .
